examples.input: Concentrated HCl is added to an unknown sample solution (which is colorless); no precipitate forms. Then H2S gas is bubbled through the resulting solution; a black precipitate forms. After filtering the black precipitate, addition of 2 mL (NH4)2S 0.5 M to 1 mL of the filtrate does not cause any precipitations. Addition of excess NaHCO3 to this solution causes a white precipitate to form. The filtrate gives a red flame test. The white precipitate from NaHCO3 dissolves in dilute HNO3, resulting in a solution that also gives a red flame test. Which of the following options can correctly describe the contents of the unknown sample?
